failures.trigger: Returning from collection to Home after journal/pagination and 720x1600 resize produced repeated RangeError: Invalid typed array length in MeshBuffer.uploadBuffers
failures.rootCause: Custom UI mesh assembler incremented indexOffset without checking index-buffer capacity. Dense meshes exceed StaticVBAccessor default capacity; upload exception prevents per-frame reset and subsequent offsets accumulate. Native appendIndices explicitly grows capacity.
failures.reference: Creator 3.8.8 cocos/2d/renderer/static-vb-accessor.ts appendIndices and mesh-buffer.ts uploadBuffers
failures.fix: Grow and copy the index buffer before custom mesh writes, matching native 1.25 growth policy. Regression exercises real assembler with undersized buffer and 1000 reused frames.
failures.verification: 238 tests pass; v4 replayed journal/pagination/720x1600 return, Home visibly rendering, inspected own-source errors empty. Actual Home chest re-entry succeeded; second 720x1280 return stayed alive with automatic merit and no own-source error logs through 2026-10-11T16:10:46.913Z.
failures.limitation: This is a game renderer error; no evidence establishes it as the cause of previous Codex desktop SIGTRAP crashes.
